university: Tunku Abdul Rahman University of Management and Technology
program_name: Bachelor of Construction Management and Economics (Honours)

fees.notes: TAR UMT official programme page: estimated total international fees RM79,000 (inclusive of 6% SST). Source: https://fobe.tarc.edu.my/programmes/bachelors-degree/bachelor-of-construction-management-and-economics-honours (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: (1) STPM - Grade C in 2 relevant subjects listed in Schedule A (2) A Level - Grade D in 2 relevant subjects listed in Schedule A (3) UEC - Grade B in 5 relevant subjects listed in Schedule A (4) Other IHL - Relevant Foundation or Diploma accredited by MQA (5) TAR UC - Foundation in Arts (Track A) OR Diploma accredited by MQA Compulsory subject: i) (1), (2), (3) and (4) must include SPM Credit/ O Level Grade C/ UEC Grade B in one mathematics subject# ii)(1), (2), (3) and (4) must include SPM Pass/ O Level Grade E (Pass)/ UEC Grade C in English Language** #Grade B and above in AMMS0104 General Mathematics conducted by TAR UC is accepted as having fulfilled the Mathematics requirement for applicants with a pass in SPM/Grade D or Grade E (pass) in O Level/Grade C in UEC in the required Mathematics subject. **Grade C and above in AELE0364 English Language conducted by TAR UC is accepted as having fulfilled the English Language requirement for applicants who fail English Language at SPM/O Level/UEC. Note: a) Students without a credit in SPM Bahasa Melayu are required to pass Bahasa Kebangsaan A before the award of Bachelor Degree. b) TAR UC Diploma will be accepted on credit transfer into Bachelor Degree programmes. c) Equivalent qualifications/qualifications from other Institution of Higher Learning (IHL) will be considered on a case-by-case basis. d) Subject to the Ministry of Higher Education latest requirements.
